apps.name: FlipFocus
apps.subtitle: Flip your phone. Focus your mind.
apps.localizedDescription:
FlipFocus turns your phone into a focus tool. Place your phone face down and the timer starts automatically; flip it back up and your session ends. Track streaks, choose from multiple ASCII and minimal themes, and stay off your phone while you work.

Features:
• Motion-based focus detection — flip face down to start
• Focus streaks and stats
• Multiple themes (ASCII jelly, minimal, custom)
• Break timer with end-of-break sound

privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: This app uses the motion sensor to detect when your phone is face down to start focusing.
